name: SVR Poker Android
updateMessage: An optional SVR Poker Android update is available.
updateMenuPolicy: Hidden unless releaseReady is true, apkUrl is non-empty, and apkVersionCode is newer than the installed code.
notes: Phase 355 changes only the remotely loaded Android web runtime; it does not require reinstalling APK 0.1.0-rc1.
The Android critical table became playable in 7.7635 seconds in the passing Android-sized Chromium run.
The passing run completed preflop, flop, turn, river, showdown, winner settlement, and NEXT HAND on its first attempt.
The passing run produced no page errors, console errors, same-origin HTTP errors, request failures, critical module failures, deferred module failures, or oversized resources.
Retired FBX recovery loops and earlier Android controller generations are excluded from Android startup.
Table geometry and card meshes initialize before the poker engine begins dealing.
Lobby decoration, profile, avatar, and presence modules load after the table becomes playable.
Missing legacy texture requests use lightweight local substitutes instead of failed network requests.
The renderer is capped at Android pixel ratio 1.2 or lower and shadows remain disabled for stable mobile performance.
This release is a local play-money game against five bots; server-authoritative internet poker is not claimed.
No native Android wrapper source, signing identity, or installable RC2 APK is currently present in the repository.
Forced updates and recurring update prompts remain disabled.
